description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter called ProductAdapter for displaying a paginated list of Product objects in an Android app. It includes view holder binding logic, diffing strategy for efficient updates, and view inflation.

classes.name: ProductAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for paginated Product items, extending PagingDataAdapter with internal diff callback for item comparison.

classes.name: ProductViewHolder
classes.description: Inner class representing the view holder that binds Product data to the UI components.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item layout and creates a ProductViewHolder instance.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the view holder and triggers a subtle appear animation for new items.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Product object's properties to UI elements in the view.
